claims.evidence: CLE=Trypsin/P; legend says tryptic digestion. reconcile flagged it only because the PRIDE record text does not name trypsin.
Mascot TOL/ITOL as deposited; unusually wide precursor tolerance reported as-is.

claims.location: comment[fractionation method], comment[dissociation method], comment[reduction reagent]
claims.evidence: SCX pH-gradient fractionation, HCD MS/MS, 0.1 M DTT in SDT lysis buffer.

limitations: The mapping of the 10 matched patient pairs (ER1/LR1..ER10/LR10) to groups G1..G5 is not published; sources are named G<n>_ER_A/LR_A/ER_B/LR_B and individual, age, disease stage, smoking are not available.
The channel layout comes from the generic Fig 1A scheme (ER_A=114/LR_A=115/ER_B=116/LR_B=117 forward, reversed for R); no deposited file states it per plex.

Alkylation reagent not stated in the record (Carbamidomethyl is Fixed in the deposited search). Collision energy 42 NCE read from the raw header of one file (G1F_F01) only; assumed constant across all 62 files.
Supplementary Table S1 lists age, smoking, TNM and stage per ER/LR patient, but the patient-to-plex mapping is unpublished, so these stay not available.
Differential labelling by F/R: it is assumed G<n>F and G<n>R contain the same four samples (Methods: both orders).
